t: A fast STM32 family with Ethernet, screen and camera support for big projects.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-F767ZI from DigiKey or the ST eStore for about 24 to 34 US dollars.
Download the MicroPython firmware for the NUCLEO-F767ZI from the MicroPython website.
Plug the board in through the ST-LINK USB port and follow the flashing steps on that page.
Open a serial terminal and type a command to blink an LED.
Try the Arduino IDE with the STM32duino board package as a second path.
Upload the Blink example and watch the onboard LEDs.
Move to a Discovery kit later for touchscreen and audio projects.
